text:
24. As appropriate, paragraph 3.30 or 3.31, should apply to any photograph or video taken as
in paragraph 23.

25. If any person is asked to leave an identification parade because they are interfering with its
conduct, the circumstances shall be recorded.

26. A record must be made of all those present at an identification parade whose names are
known to the police.

27. If prison inmates make up an identification parade, the circumstances must be recorded.

28. A record of the conduct of any identification parade must be made on forms provided for the
purpose. This shall include anything said by the witness or the suspect about any
identifications or the conduct of the procedure, and any reasons it was not practicable to
comply with any of this Code’s provisions.
